# Total.js knowledge

> Total.js 5 knowledge in one place: the conventions (ES5 first, Total.js prototypes and Tangular first, no imports from Node.js, pipe-separated action names, routes in controllers or in the plugin) and small complete applications, tested, that show them at work.

Read the general rules, then the pages of the zone you work in, and look at the application with the shape you need. Written for Total.js 5 (`total5` on npm) and jComponent 20.

## Start here

- [README](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/totaljs-es/knowledge/main/README.md): What is here: the conventions, the applications and the rules of both
- [AGENTS.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/totaljs-es/knowledge/main/AGENTS.md): For an agent: how to use these pages and the rules that apply to every change
## General

- [Write and refactor workflow](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/totaljs-es/knowledge/main/conventions/general/workflow.md): Select a reference, preserve contracts, correct code and verify behaviour
- [Native patterns](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/totaljs-es/knowledge/main/conventions/general/native-patterns.md): Direct framework calls, existing helpers and execution context
- [Project structure](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/totaljs-es/knowledge/main/conventions/general/project-structure.md): Native runtime folders, private inputs, internal docs/examples, entry point and move checks
- [JavaScript style](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/totaljs-es/knowledge/main/conventions/general/javascript-style.md): ES5 over ES6, prototypes and Tangular first, no imports from Node.js, formatting and names
- [Native tests and tools](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/totaljs-es/knowledge/main/conventions/general/testing.md): Direct total5/test bootstrap, suite config, disposable databases and visual verification
## Backend

- [Actions](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/totaljs-es/knowledge/main/conventions/backend/actions.md): NEWACTION: naming with a pipe, input and params, answers, permissions, DATA
- [Standalone actions with tests](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/totaljs-es/knowledge/main/conventions/backend/action-kits.md): Folder per action, contract, suite config, small samples, database integration, local-server tests and the checker
- [Routes and authentication](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/totaljs-es/knowledge/main/conventions/backend/routes-and-auth.md): ROUTE syntax for APIs, pages and uploads, and the single AUTH
- [Definitions and modules](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/totaljs-es/knowledge/main/conventions/backend/definitions-and-modules.md): auth, init, func and db, config, automatic MODS loading, lifecycle and standalone-tool boundaries
- [Storage and integrations](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/totaljs-es/knowledge/main/conventions/backend/storage-and-integrations.md): Existing persistence, RESTBuilder, configuration and lifecycle
- [Gotchas of the server](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/totaljs-es/knowledge/main/conventions/backend/gotchas.md): Behaviours that differ from what you would guess
## Database

- [SQL scripts](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/totaljs-es/knowledge/main/conventions/database/sql-scripts.md): PostgreSQL files, names, columns, order of the columns, code lists
- [Queries with DATA](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/totaljs-es/knowledge/main/conventions/database/queries.md): read, find, autoquery, insert, modify, remove, conditions, raw SQL
## Frontend

- [Components](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/totaljs-es/knowledge/main/conventions/frontend/components.md): Use the existing jComponent components, preferred ones, exec, intranetcss, COMPONENTATOR()
- [Plugins with UI](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/totaljs-es/knowledge/main/conventions/frontend/plugins-ui.md): Server part, screens, forms, PLUGIN() and tapi
- [Views and layout](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/totaljs-es/knowledge/main/conventions/frontend/views-and-layout.md): The layout, directives, translations, public pages
- [Tangular templates](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/totaljs-es/knowledge/main/conventions/frontend/tangular.md): Values and encoding, conditions, loops, the helpers and your own helper; every example run
- [Binding and forms](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/totaljs-es/knowledge/main/conventions/frontend/binding-and-forms.md): Connected screen/importer/form flow, binding, translations and lifecycle
- [CMS widgets](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/totaljs-es/knowledge/main/conventions/frontend/cms-widgets.md): Native single-file format, metadata, settings, scoped CSS, rendering and previews
- [CSS](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/totaljs-es/knowledge/main/conventions/frontend/css.md): Formatting, CLASS scoping, predefined classes
## jComponent

- [jComponent 20: the official guides](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/totaljs-es/knowledge/main/reference/jcomponent/readme.md): Where these guides come from and what each one is
- [Use a component: ui-component](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/totaljs-es/knowledge/main/reference/jcomponent/aicontext/ui-component.md): name, path, config, default and the special keys
- [Bind data: ui-bind](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/totaljs-es/knowledge/main/reference/jcomponent/aicontext/ui-bind.md): Text, HTML, templates, classes and visibility from a path
- [A screen with its scope: ui-plugin](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/totaljs-es/knowledge/main/reference/jcomponent/aicontext/ui-plugin.md): ui-plugin and PLUGIN(), the ? of paths and methods
- [Load a part when needed: ui-import](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/totaljs-es/knowledge/main/reference/jcomponent/aicontext/ui-import.md): Dynamic content of the interface
- [The API of the library](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/totaljs-es/knowledge/main/reference/jcomponent/api.md): The methods of the library and what a component can implement
- [Write a component](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/totaljs-es/knowledge/main/reference/jcomponent/aicontext/component-development.md): From a description to a component: contract, hooks, data flow, verification
- [jComponent 20: the published components](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/totaljs-es/knowledge/main/reference/components/readme.md): The catalogue: every published component by name with what it does; look here before writing a piece of interface by hand
- [Total Icons: the names](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/totaljs-es/knowledge/main/reference/icons.md): The names of the icons of the library, used as ti ti-name; a name that is not in the list draws nothing
## Reference

- [What Total.js 5 0.0.20 adds](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/totaljs-es/knowledge/main/reference/total5-0.0.20.md): MCP tools from actions, the cache of an action, the types JSON and IP, $.content, the environment of an action, total5 test and fakes; each one tried with the beta

## Questions

- [The application: questions and answers](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/totaljs-es/knowledge/main/questions/application.md): Folders, the start script, config, helpers, state, modules, plugins or not, packages and versions
- [Actions: questions and answers](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/totaljs-es/knowledge/main/questions/actions.md): NEWACTION: names, input, params, query, answers, errors, permissions and calls between actions
- [Routes and authentication: questions and answers](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/totaljs-es/knowledge/main/questions/routes.md): API routes, pages, AUTH, a token, BLOCKED, body limits and 404
- [Data with DATA: questions and answers](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/totaljs-es/knowledge/main/questions/data.md): The embedded database with the prefix nosql/, read and write, filters, autoquery, PostgreSQL and raw SQL
- [Storage and files: questions and answers](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/totaljs-es/knowledge/main/questions/storage.md): Which storage, MEMORIZE, NOSQL, uploads and FILESTORAGE
- [Scheduled work, HTTP calls and WebSocket: questions and answers](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/totaljs-es/knowledge/main/questions/services.md): ON(service), CRON, RESTBuilder, SOCKET routes and errors without a request
- [Views and pages: questions and answers](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/totaljs-es/knowledge/main/questions/views.md): $.view, the layout, loops and conditions, the title, translations and static files
- [Tangular templates: questions and answers](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/totaljs-es/knowledge/main/questions/tangular.md): Values, raw, conditions, loops, helpers and templates in a ui-bind
- [The interface with jComponent 20: questions and answers](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/totaljs-es/knowledge/main/questions/interface.md): Plugins, screens, tapi, exec, CLASS, components, COMPONENTATOR, forms and CSS
- [SQL scripts for PostgreSQL: questions and answers](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/totaljs-es/knowledge/main/questions/sql.md): database.sql, names of tables and columns, types, code lists and the order of a script
- [Style, tests and versions: questions and answers](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/totaljs-es/knowledge/main/questions/style-and-tests.md): ES5 first, Total.Fs, format, tests, the version of Total.js 5 and what to do when not sure
- [Mail, translations, redirects, CORS, encryption, cache and threads: questions and answers](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/totaljs-es/knowledge/main/questions/server.md): MAIL and HTMLMAIL, resources and LOCALIZE, $.redirect, the route #404, CORS, the request limit, ENCRYPT and DECRYPT, CACHE and NEWTHREAD
- [Helpers of texts, numbers, dates and lists, cookies, headers and middleware: questions and answers](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/totaljs-es/knowledge/main/questions/helpers.md): slug, isEmail, parseJSON, format, sha256, toSearch, pluralize, dates with add, quicksort, findItem, GUID, CLONE, QUERIFY, $.cookie, $.headers, MIDDLEWARE and wildcard routes
- [The browser: state, events, storage, requests, uploads and pages without a reload: questions and answers](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/totaljs-es/knowledge/main/questions/browser.md): SET and GET, inc, toggle and push, ui-bind show, watch, EMIT and ON, EXEC, CACHE, PREF, COOKIES, AJAX, UPLOAD with progress, ROUTE and REDIRECT in the browser, NAV and ENV
- [Sessions, Markdown, a cache on disk, templates, backups, maintenance, commands and audit: questions and answers](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/totaljs-es/knowledge/main/questions/operations.md): Sign in with a session and a cookie, markdown, FILECACHE, TEMPLATE, BACKUP and RESTORE, PAUSESERVER, SHELL, DIFFARR, DOWNLOAD, LOGMAIL, $.audit, MERGE, minified static files, PROXY and a CSRF token

## Applications

- [Contacts: an API without plugins](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/totaljs-es/knowledge/main/apps/contacts/readme.md): Actions, routes in controllers, a token and DATA on the embedded NoSQL database
- [Contacts on PostgreSQL](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/totaljs-es/knowledge/main/apps/contacts-postgresql/readme.md): The same queries with DATA on PostgreSQL: the definition of the database and the table names without the prefix nosql/
- [Files: upload and download](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/totaljs-es/knowledge/main/apps/files/readme.md): A multipart upload with a size limit, FILESTORAGE, a FILE route for the download and the removal
- [Monitor: work on a schedule](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/totaljs-es/knowledge/main/apps/monitor/readme.md): ON(service) and CRON, a request to another server with RESTBuilder, and a small state kept with MEMORIZE
- [Website: views and a layout](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/totaljs-es/knowledge/main/apps/website/readme.md): Public pages rendered on the server, without plugins and without a database
- [Chat: a room over a WebSocket](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/totaljs-es/knowledge/main/apps/chat/readme.md): A SOCKET route with its open, close and message events, and the websocket component in the browser
- [Accounts: sign in, sessions and what belongs to each user](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/totaljs-es/knowledge/main/apps/accounts/readme.md): The object given to AUTH, authcookie and logout, the page to sign in for a request without a session, an administrator that the action checks, and notes that only their user sees
- [Board: an application with plugins](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/totaljs-es/knowledge/main/apps/board/readme.md): Each feature with its routes, actions, screen and form, in jComponent 20
## Components

- [j-AjaxLoading (ajaxloading)](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/totaljs-es/knowledge/main/reference/components/ajaxloading.md): This component can show a loading text for async AJAX operations.
- [j-Animation (animation)](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/totaljs-es/knowledge/main/reference/components/animation.md): This component can animate elements with .animation class.
- [j-Approve (approve)](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/totaljs-es/knowledge/main/reference/components/approve.md): Singleton modal confirmation dialog with approve and cancel buttons that runs a callback when the user approves
- [j-ASelected (aselected)](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/totaljs-es/knowledge/main/reference/components/aselected.md): Adds a selected class to links whose href matches the current browser address, intended for public websites
- [j-Attachments (attachments)](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/totaljs-es/knowledge/main/reference/components/attachments.md): The component displays attachments in the simple list.
- [j-Audio (audio)](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/totaljs-es/knowledge/main/reference/components/audio.md): Singleton audio player that plays and stops MP3 sounds from a URL, with a volume control
- [j-AutoComplete (autocomplete)](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/totaljs-es/knowledge/main/reference/components/autocomplete.md): Shows search suggestions under an input or contenteditable field from a search function and passes the chosen value to a callback
- [j-AutoDarkMode (autodarkmode)](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/totaljs-es/knowledge/main/reference/components/autodarkmode.md): The component automatically applies dark mode according to the operation system.
- [j-AutoExec (autoexec)](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/totaljs-es/knowledge/main/reference/components/autoexec.md): This component automatically executes a method defined in exec option.
- [j-AutoFill (autofill)](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/totaljs-es/knowledge/main/reference/components/autofill.md): Wraps all nested elements in a form element with form events disabled
- [j-AutoSelect (autoselect)](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/totaljs-es/knowledge/main/reference/components/autoselect.md): The component automatically adds .selected class according to the selector class="autoselect" within the entire HTML document.
- [j-Avatar (avatar)](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/totaljs-es/knowledge/main/reference/components/avatar.md): Avatar component needs to register your own theme.
- [j-BackToTop (backtotop)](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/totaljs-es/knowledge/main/reference/components/backtotop.md): Singleton button that appears when the page is scrolled down and scrolls the page back to the top
- [j-Backup (backup)](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/totaljs-es/knowledge/main/reference/components/backup.md): The component for data saving data to and loading from the local storage of the browser.
- [j-Banners (banners)](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/totaljs-es/knowledge/main/reference/components/banners.md): Responsive banner rotator that cycles through slides at a set interval, with navigation icons
- [j-BarChart (barchart)](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/totaljs-es/knowledge/main/reference/components/barchart.md): Please review an example and keep a data-source.
- [j-Box (box)](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/totaljs-es/knowledge/main/reference/components/box.md): Modal form with a title, icon and submit and cancel handlers, shown when its path value matches the if condition
- [j-Breadcrumb (breadcrumb)](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/totaljs-es/knowledge/main/reference/components/breadcrumb.md): Breadcrumb navigation trail built from a data source, with a root link, configurable icons and an optional document title
- [j-Button (button)](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/totaljs-es/knowledge/main/reference/components/button.md): A simple button component with great features.
- [j-Calendar (calendar)](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/totaljs-es/knowledge/main/reference/components/calendar.md): The component must be called manually or works with textbox or j-Input component automatically.
- [j-Carousel (carousel)](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/totaljs-es/knowledge/main/reference/components/carousel.md): Content carousel with swipe gestures, automatic animation at a set interval and left and right controls
- [j-Carousel2 (carousel2)](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/totaljs-es/knowledge/main/reference/components/carousel2.md): If the component's path is changed then the component summarizes all cells again.
- [j-Centered (centered)](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/totaljs-es/knowledge/main/reference/components/centered.md): Centered modal form moved under the body tag that appears when its path value matches the if condition, with close options
- [j-Changer (changer)](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/totaljs-es/knowledge/main/reference/components/changer.md): This component captures inline changes and can affect the validate component.
- [j-Checkbox (checkbox)](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/totaljs-es/knowledge/main/reference/components/checkbox.md): Checkbox bound to a data path, with an optional label, required and disabled states, and a reverse mode
- [j-Checkboxlist (checkboxlist)](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/totaljs-es/knowledge/main/reference/components/checkboxlist.md): Group of checkboxes built from static items or a data source, bound to a path as a list of selected values

- [j-TangularColor (tangular-color)](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/totaljs-es/knowledge/main/reference/components/tangular-color.md): A simple Tangular template engine helper for rendering colors from the string.
- [j-TangularCounter (tangular-counter)](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/totaljs-es/knowledge/main/reference/components/tangular-counter.md): This helper can create a short value from big numbers.
- [j-TangularFileSize (tangular-filesize)](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/totaljs-es/knowledge/main/reference/components/tangular-filesize.md): Tangular helper and Number prototype that render a file size in a human readable form.
- [j-TangularInitials (tangular-initials)](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/totaljs-es/knowledge/main/reference/components/tangular-initials.md): A simple Tangular template engine helper for rendering initials from the name (firstname + lastname).
- [j-TangularJsonFormat (tangular-jsonformat)](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/totaljs-es/knowledge/main/reference/components/tangular-jsonformat.md): A simple Tangular helper for formatting of objects to more readable JSON.
- [j-TangularRGBA (tangular-rgba)](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/totaljs-es/knowledge/main/reference/components/tangular-rgba.md): A simple Tangular template engine helper for transforming hex colors to RGBA colors.
- [j-TangularTime (tangular-time)](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/totaljs-es/knowledge/main/reference/components/tangular-time.md): A simple Tangular template engine helper for rendering humanable date and time.
- [j-Template (template)](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/totaljs-es/knowledge/main/reference/components/template.md): Renders a Tangular template with the bound model and hides itself when the model is null or undefined
- [j-Templates (templates)](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/totaljs-es/knowledge/main/reference/components/templates.md): Renders a list from named templates, with drag and drop, custom scrollbars, context menu and an empty template
- [j-Textarea (textarea)](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/totaljs-es/knowledge/main/reference/components/textarea.md): Multi-line text field with label, icon, placeholder, length limit, error text and optional monospace font
- [j-Textbox (textbox)](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/totaljs-es/knowledge/main/reference/components/textbox.md): Text input with label, icons, placeholder, length limits, type rules and validation for email, phone, date and number
- [j-TextboxList (textboxlist)](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/totaljs-es/knowledge/main/reference/components/textboxlist.md): Input that adds entries to a list, with a maximum limit, type rules, error text and optional reordering of items
- [j-TextboxTags (textboxtags)](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/totaljs-es/knowledge/main/reference/components/textboxtags.md): Tag input that stores entered words as an array or string, with optional lowercase or uppercase conversion
- [j-Time (time)](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/totaljs-es/knowledge/main/reference/components/time.md): This component renders a current time.
- [j-TimePicker (timepicker)](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/totaljs-es/knowledge/main/reference/components/timepicker.md): The component must be called manually or works with j-Input component automatically.
- [j-Title (title)](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/totaljs-es/knowledge/main/reference/components/title.md): Sets the browser document title from a bound value, combined with a site name and a separator
- [j-ToggleBox (togglebox)](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/totaljs-es/knowledge/main/reference/components/togglebox.md): ToggleBox can re-order or hide items in Array.
- [j-ToggleButton (togglebutton)](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/totaljs-es/knowledge/main/reference/components/togglebutton.md): Icons can be in the form: circle or ti ti-circle.
- [j-ToggleMore (togglemore)](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/totaljs-es/knowledge/main/reference/components/togglemore.md): Is a simple component to toggle content.
- [j-TooltipCSS (tooltip-css)](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/totaljs-es/knowledge/main/reference/components/tooltip-css.md): CSS-only tooltips based on the tooltip attribute, positioned with tooltip-position.
- [j-Tooltip (tooltip)](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/totaljs-es/knowledge/main/reference/components/tooltip.md): Singleton tooltip shown next to an element with HTML content, offset, alignment and optional auto-hide timeout
- [j-TotalTemplates (totaltemplates)](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/totaljs-es/knowledge/main/reference/components/totaltemplates.md): This component can render Total.js Templates.
- [j-TouchMove (touchmove)](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/totaljs-es/knowledge/main/reference/components/touchmove.md): Simple touchmove component for easy touch navigation next/prev/up/down.
- [j-Tour (tour)](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/totaljs-es/knowledge/main/reference/components/tour.md): Step-by-step guided tour that highlights target elements from a data-source, with keyboard navigation and custom button texts
- [j-Tree (tree)](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/totaljs-es/knowledge/main/reference/components/tree.md): Setter automatically extends each object by adding .$pointer property with a tree index.
- [j-TreeView (treeview)](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/totaljs-es/knowledge/main/reference/components/treeview.md): This component is only a beta preview.
- [j-Typed (typed)](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/totaljs-es/knowledge/main/reference/components/typed.md): Typing animation that types out an array of texts with the typed.js library, with speed, loop and cursor options
- [j-UIBuilder (uibuilder)](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/totaljs-es/knowledge/main/reference/components/uibuilder.md): This component renders the application designed via UI Builder.
- [j-UIEditor (uieditor)](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/totaljs-es/knowledge/main/reference/components/uieditor.md): The component opens UI Builder in the iframe.
- [j-UIStudio (uistudio)](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/totaljs-es/knowledge/main/reference/components/uistudio.md): This component renders the app according to the Total.js Flow UI Studio schema.
- [j-Unsaved (unsaved)](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/totaljs-es/knowledge/main/reference/components/unsaved.md): Warns the user before leaving the page when the bound value or a check function reports unsaved changes
- [j-Upload (upload)](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/totaljs-es/knowledge/main/reference/components/upload.md): The component can perform uploading of files.
- [j-URLify (urlify)](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/totaljs-es/knowledge/main/reference/components/urlify.md): This method finds all URL addresses and creates links.
- [j-Validate (validate)](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/totaljs-es/knowledge/main/reference/components/validate.md): The component contains the same source-code as the j-Validation component.
- [j-Validation (validation)](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/totaljs-es/knowledge/main/reference/components/validation.md): The component contains the same source-code as the j-Validate component.
- [j-View (view)](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/totaljs-es/knowledge/main/reference/components/view.md): This component can be helpful for reusable views in intranet apps.
- [j-ViewBox (viewbox)](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/totaljs-es/knowledge/main/reference/components/viewbox.md): Container with a fixed percentage height of its parent or window, with optional scrolling, centering and disabled overlay
- [j-VirtualWire (virtualwire)](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/totaljs-es/knowledge/main/reference/components/virtualwire.md): This is a very special UI component that can move elements from element to another element according to the selector and the value of the path.
- [j-Watch (watch)](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/totaljs-es/knowledge/main/reference/components/watch.md): The component can evaluate the method in the form function(value, element, type, path) when the value (according to the path) is changed.
- [j-Watcher (watcher)](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/totaljs-es/knowledge/main/reference/components/watcher.md): Runs the code in a script tag of type text/js whenever the bound value changes, with access to value and path
- [j-WebMCP (webmcp)](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/totaljs-es/knowledge/main/reference/components/webmcp.md): Exposes the Total.js 5 MCP tools to WebMCP-capable browsers
- [j-WebSocket (websocket)](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/totaljs-es/knowledge/main/reference/components/websocket.md): With this component, you can receive data via WebSocket.
- [j-Wiki (wiki)](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/totaljs-es/knowledge/main/reference/components/wiki.md): Great component for inline Wiki/Documentation.
- [j-Window (window)](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/totaljs-es/knowledge/main/reference/components/window.md): Modal window shown when a condition on the bound value matches, with optional closing on Escape and submit on Enter
- [j-Windows (windows)](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/totaljs-es/knowledge/main/reference/components/windows.md): The windows component expects an Array of objects.
- [j-WizardExpert (wizardexpert)](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/totaljs-es/knowledge/main/reference/components/wizardexpert.md): A simple solution for making of advanced wizards.
- [j-Wysiwyg (wysiwyg)](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/totaljs-es/knowledge/main/reference/components/wysiwyg.md): Rich text editor with formatting, code highlighting, links and unordered lists, supporting dark mode and optional raw paste
- [j-Xterm (xterm)](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/totaljs-es/knowledge/main/reference/components/xterm.md): The component renders a terminal output/input directly in the web browser.
